text:
Ashley (Sales): Heads-up — Lumina Bank pushed the SIG and wants question-by-question evidence. Deadline Friday EOD. can we triage? :calendar:
Raj (Security): I can own crypto/KMS/network controls. point me to where we stash artifacts today.
Olivia (Eng): I'll pull runtime/isolation logs and TLS cert chain. where do you want uploads — this thread or shared bucket?
Ashley (Sales): put final artifacts in the shared SIG folder + drop a copy here. path: /shared/sigs/lumina_bank/ so QA can zip. also include a short cover note per question.
Chris (Solutions): FYI POC env details: IP allowlist already sent to lumina. they also asked for egress monitoring evidence (flow logs). I have screenshots.
Raj (Security): For Q13 (KMS rotation) we need: rotation-policy.pdf, rotation-audit.csv, and a signed note on key custody. filename convention: lumina_q13_kms-rotation-YYYYMMDD.zip
Olivia (Eng): I exported the cert chain and runtime isolation screenshots. uploading now.
Olivia (Eng): ```
S3: s3://redwood-sec-artifacts/lumina/q13/lumina_q13_kms-rotation-20240512.zip
Contents: rotation-policy.pdf, rotation-audit.csv, rotation-audit.log
``` 
Raj (Security): perfect. Also attach the HSM attestation (if available) or a vendor SOC statement. I can redact customer-facing IPs.
sec-bot: Automated reminder — SIG schema v2 adopted. Use control IDs in filenames: e.g., Q13_control-KMS_v2. Docs: https://internal.redwood/sec/sig-v2
Ashley (Sales): Lumina also asked how we handle data residency for their EU tenants. quick answer so I can pass back?
Raj (Security): We offer region pinning for Dedicated and Private; Hosted can route to eu-west region. Include policy doc: data-residency.pdf
Olivia (Eng): For the POC they want a short runbook for spinning a private pod — I'll attach runbook.md and a sanitized `kubectl` snippet.
Olivia (Eng): ```
# snippet (sanitized)
kubectl apply -f redwood-poc-deployment.yaml --namespace=lumi-poc
``` 
Chris (Solutions): On pricing: Lumina requested Dedicated vs Hosted for ~100k token/day. I gave a rough estimate but we need final approval for POC discount.
Ashley (Sales): @Finance sign-off needed for 50% POC discount month 1. I'll escalate if no response by EOD.
Raj (Security): Question on Q21 (cert revocation) — do we have CRL/OCSP proof? I can generate a short note referencing our PKI ops.
Olivia (Eng): I attached flow logs and OCSP check screenshots to the shared folder.
Ashley (Sales): Nice. I'm assembling the ZIP now. plan: one zip per question with a one-line cover note and control-id in filename.
Chris (Solutions): I'll review the cover notes for accuracy.
Raj (Security): I'll do a final security sign-off on each question I own. ping me when zipped.
Ashley (Sales): Updated plan timeline: triage today, assemble artifacts tomorrow morning, internal sign-offs by noon, send to Lumina Friday EOD. any blockers?
Raj (Security): none from my side. might need a quick redact pass for internal IPs — @Olivia please mark logs that contain private ranges.
Olivia (Eng): will do. uploading redacted versions now.
sec-bot: Audit log: user Olivia uploaded 7 files to /shared/sigs/lumina_bank at 2024-05-12T14:22:10Z
Ashley (Sales): Thanks team — I'll post the final ZIP here once ready and paste the email text for Lumina. :thumbsup:
